headline.en: Make editorial feedback repeatable across drafts.
headline.zh: 让不同草稿使用同一套编辑反馈标准。

sub.en: Wenti packages an editorial voice card, examples and a four-dimension rubric for Chinese long-form writing. It offers local heuristic scoring and optional model-based scoring or rewriting.
sub.zh: Wenti 将编辑视角卡、示例与四维评分标准打包，用于中文长文。它提供本地启发式评分，以及可选模型评分或重写。

body.en: The same pack can be selected for each draft.
body.zh: 每篇草稿可选择相同 pack。

body.en: Dimension weights and local rules are source visible.
body.zh: 维度权重与本地规则均有源码。
明确 dry-run 让评分留在本地。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: The example includes an original Chinese scene and runs score_draft with dry_run=True so no credentials or network are used.
note.zh: 示例包含原创中文场景，并以 dry_run=True 运行 score_draft，不使用凭据或网络。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Local heuristic scoring of an original short Chinese fixture using the bundled sanlian pack; no model judgment, rewrite or measured editorial improvement.

body.en: The example includes an original Chinese scene and runs score_draft with dry_run=True so no credentials or network are used.
body.zh: 示例包含原创中文场景，并以 dry_run=True 运行 score_draft，不使用凭据或网络。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/wenti.git
cd wenti
uv venv .venv
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .
source .venv/bin/activate

limitations.en: The heuristic rewards specific wording and sentence/paragraph features. Its score is not an objective measure of writing quality or an independent editorial assessment.
limitations.zh: 启发式奖励特定用词和句段特征；分数不是客观写作质量，也不是独立编辑评估。

limitations.en: The bundled sanlian label names a project pack; this page does not claim endorsement by a publication.
limitations.zh: 随仓 sanlian 名称指项目 pack，不表示刊物背书。

limitations.en: The offline demo scores an original short fixture and does not demonstrate a model rewrite or improved reader outcomes.
limitations.zh: 离线示例只为原创短 fixture 评分，不展示模型重写或读者效果提升。

body.en: Repeatedly restating a preferred writing direction makes drafts harder to compare. A named pack and explicit rubric let a writer reuse the same criteria while retaining editorial judgment.
body.zh: 反复重述偏好文风会让草稿难以比较。命名 pack 与明确标准便于作者重复使用同一组条件，同时保留编辑判断。

body.en: The pack loader reads voice-card metadata and examples. score_draft chooses an explicit dry-run heuristic or a configured model path. Four sub-scores are combined by rubric weights and accompanied by suggestions. rewrite uses the selected pack through its own path.
body.zh: pack 加载器读取视角卡元数据与示例。score_draft 选择明确 dry-run 启发式或已配置模型路径；四个分项按权重合成并附建议。rewrite 使用独立路径应用选定 pack。

body.en: The pack loader reads voice-card metadata and examples. score_draft chooses an explicit dry-run heuristic or a configured model path. Four sub-scores are combined by rubric weights and accompanied by suggestions. rewrite uses the selected pack through its own path.
body.zh: pack 加载器读取视角卡元数据与示例。score_draft 选择明确 dry-run 启发式或已配置模型路径；四个分项按权重合成并附建议。rewrite 使用独立路径应用选定 pack。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: WENTI_BASE_URL and WENTI_API_KEY enable the model path; WENTI_MODEL selects its model. --dry-run forces local scoring even when credentials exist. rubric.yaml weights sentence structure and wording at 0.3 each, rhythm and perspective at 0.2 each.
body.zh: WENTI_BASE_URL 与 WENTI_API_KEY 启用模型路径，WENTI_MODEL 指定模型。即使已有凭据，--dry-run 也强制本地评分。rubric.yaml 中句式和用词各占 0.3，节奏和视角各占 0.2。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
wenti list
wenti score draft.md --pack sanlian --dry-run --json
# Model-backed rewrite uses the configured endpoint:
wenti rewrite draft.md --pack sanlian
